summary: Flat dip near the lane's north bend; cars park here, homes 17 m off.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 17 m at the north end of the section, 33 m and further elsewhere; bush and gardens between; tennis courts to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; several cars parked beside it at the north end, so it is used for parking.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs are 2P resident permit Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Construction site 9 m away near 106 m
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy on both sides, especially the east; shaded much of the day.
cannot_judge: Room to pass a parked van in the narrow lane

best_section.where: West kerb in the low dip before the lane bends north to the junction
